jdbc.diagram:
sequenceDiagram
  participant A as 애플리케이션
  participant M as DataSource·DriverManager
  participant C as Connection
  participant S as PreparedStatement
  participant D as DBMS(드라이버)
  A->>M: getConnection()
  M->>D: 드라이버로 연결 수립
  M-->>A: Connection
  A->>C: prepareStatement(sql)
  C-->>A: PreparedStatement
  A->>S: 파라미터 바인딩·executeQuery()
  S->>D: SQL 실행
  D-->>S: 결과
  S-->>A: ResultSet (next()로 순회)
  A->>C: close() → 커넥션 풀 반환
